title: Launch Orchestra: Risk Playbook, Rollback Decision Tree, and Incident Comms Scripts
creator: Sofia Martinez
description:
Objective: produce a single, executable playbook and comms kit for the upcoming runtime-1.23 release that coordinates release blockers, explicit rollback gates, and templated incident communications across Eng / SRE / Product / Design / Support. Deliverables:
- Operational playbook (PDF + Confluence) with an executable rollback decision tree and ‘circuit breaker’ thresholds
- Pre-written incident comms templates (internal, external, customer-facing) and Slack escalation scripts
- Release-blocker checklist with owner assignments and gating criteria
- Canary validation checklist and automated verification queries for the launch dashboard
Why this exists: previous launches exposed unclear rollback triggers and slow cross-team coordination. This ticket standardizes a single source of truth so Product can approve/unblock, Eng can execute rollback safely, and Support has ready-made customer messages.
Key rollback triggers (examples captured in playbook):
- Sustained non-200 error rate > 5% over a 5-minute rolling window across production endpoints
- Latency p50 crossing SLA by >2x for 10+ minutes for more than 10% of requests
- Canary-model quality regression: automated eval on core prompt-set shows >3% drop in generation accuracy or >5% increase in hallucination score compared to pinned baseline
- Data exfiltration / credentials compromise detected (security immediate abort)
Playbook includes: specific owner on-call steps, pre-populated commands/scripts, required approvals for each rollback tier, and post-rollback verification steps. Links: Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/Launch-Orchestra-Risk-Playbook, GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/7152, Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/launch/overview?orgId=1, Slack: #launch-orchestra.
